items.name: Drive
items.tip: Drive: how hard the sound is saturated. Even at 0 % a very light touch of warmth stays on by design. Dynamics are kept at any input level. With the PurrOne stack character this is the opamp-style tanh stage; above 80 % it stacks a second stage.

items.name: Transistor
items.tip: Transistor: asymmetric soft clip with even harmonics, warm and thick, not buzzy. Adds on top of Drive in Shipped, and is the middle stage of the PurrOne stack.

items.name: Grit
items.tip: Grit: lopsided fuzz-style clip, above 80 % it adds a smooth octave-up growl. Adds on top of Drive in Shipped, and is the last stage of the PurrOne stack.

items.name: Drive character
items.tip: Shipped is the plain saturation (Transistor and Grit can be added on top). The PurrOne stack is the three-stage colour shaper from the PurrOne synth: opamp drive, Neve-style transistor and fuzz, nastier above 80 %, smooth (no digital fizz), with a fizz low-pass that closes as it gets nastier.

items.name: Color
items.tip: Color: emphasises one band of the sound before it is saturated. Low = bass and warmth, high = bite and air.

items.name: Fuzz
items.tip: Fuzz: adds clipped high frequencies (above about 1.5 kHz) for a buzzy, raw top end.

items.name: Stereo Turbo
items.tip: Stereo Turbo: delays the right channel by a few milliseconds for width. Check the mix in mono, too much can thin it out.

items.name: Mix
items.tip: Mix: blend between the original (dry) and the saturated (wet) sound.

items.name: Output
items.tip: Output: final level. Use it to match the loudness of the original when comparing.

top.name: Preset menu
top.tip: Factory presets (our own). Use the arrows to step through them.

top.name: Randomize
top.tip: Set the controls to random values (output level and on/off switches are kept).

top.name: Nasty range
top.tip: Nasty range: lets Drive, Fuzz, Squeeze, Warm and the other heavy knobs go far past 100 % for really nasty, OTT and Vengeance style sounds. Off keeps every knob at its normal top.

top.name: Limiter
top.tip: Safety limiter on the output: keeps the level from ever passing 0 dBFS, smooth and transparent. Turn it off if you want the raw output (for example to let your own limiter do the work).

top.name: Settings
top.tip: Settings: version, link to the GitHub page for new versions

top.name: Info bubbles (i)
top.tip: Info bubbles: hover a control for one second to see what it does. Click to turn them off or on.
